title: The Power of Faith
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.152 Numbered Discourses 4.152
  • 16. Indriyavagga 16. Faculties

Saddhābalasutta The Power of Faith

“Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, balāni. “Mendicants, there are these four powers. Katamāni cattāri? What four? Saddhābalaṁ, vīriyabalaṁ, satibalaṁ, samādhibalaṁ—The powers of faith, energy, mindfulness, and immersion. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri balānī”ti. These are the four powers.”

Dutiyaṁ.
